title: PR #47050 added the project-scoped rule snooze (mute) endpoint, which loads the issue/metric alert rule by id alone without scoping it to the project in the URL, so a user can mute alert rules in other organizations.

98:     def convert_args(
99:         self,
100:         request: Request,
101:         organization_slug: str,
102:         project_slug: str,
103:         *args,
104:         **kwargs,
105:     ):
106:         try:
107:             project = (
108:                 Project.objects.filter(organization__slug=organization_slug, slug=project_slug)
109:                 .select_related("organization")
110:                 .prefetch_related("teams")
111:                 .get()
112:             )
113:         except Project.DoesNotExist:
114:             try:
115:                 # Project may have been renamed
116:                 redirect = ProjectRedirect.objects.select_related("project")
117:                 redirect = redirect.get(
118:                     organization__slug=organization_slug, redirect_slug=project_slug
119:                 )
120:                 # Without object permissions don't reveal the rename
121:                 self.check_object_permissions(request, redirect.project)
122: 
123:                 # get full path so that we keep query strings
124:                 requested_url = request.get_full_path()
125:                 new_url = requested_url.replace(
126:                     f"projects/{organization_slug}/{project_slug}/",
127:                     f"projects/{organization_slug}/{redirect.project.slug}/",
128:                 )
129: 
130:                 # Resource was moved/renamed if the requested url is different than the new url
131:                 if requested_url != new_url:
132:                     raise ProjectMoved(new_url, redirect.project.slug)
133: 
134:                 # otherwise project doesn't exist
135:                 raise ResourceDoesNotExist
136:             except ProjectRedirect.DoesNotExist:
137:                 raise ResourceDoesNotExist
138: 
139:         if project.status != ProjectStatus.VISIBLE:
140:             raise ResourceDoesNotExist
141: 
142:         self.check_object_permissions(request, project)
143: 
144:         with configure_scope() as scope:
145:             scope.set_tag("project", project.id)
146: 
147:         bind_organization_context(project.organization)
148: 
149:         request._request.organization = project.organization
150: 
151:         kwargs["project"] = project
152:         return (args, kwargs)

154:     def get_filter_params(self, request: Request, project, date_filter_optional=False):
155:         """Similar to the version on the organization just for a single project."""
156:         # get the top level params -- projects, time range, and environment
157:         # from the request
158:         try:
159:             start, end = get_date_range_from_params(request.GET, optional=date_filter_optional)
160:         except InvalidParams as e:
161:             raise ProjectEventsError(str(e))
162: 
163:         environments = [env.name for env in get_environments(request, project.organization)]
164:         params = {"start": start, "end": end, "project_id": [project.id]}
165:         if environments:
166:             params["environment"] = environments

168:         return params
